Core concept:
- Each parallel task runs in its own git worktree
- Tasks can execute simultaneously without conflicts
- Results merged back to main branch

Implementation areas:

- Task scheduler for parallel execution
- Merge strategy for completed worktrees
- Conflict resolution handling
- Resource limits (max concurrent tasks)

Benefits:
- Faster execution for independent tasks
- No blocking on single-threaded execution
- Better utilization of API rate limits

title: Implement execution loop in session orchestrator
description:
Implement the main execution loop that processes tasks automatically.

## Location
- `src/jiro/core/session.py` - SessionOrchestrator
- `src/jiro/core/executor.py` - TaskExecutor

## Flow
```
for each ready_task in tracker.get_ready_tasks():
    1. Run task preflight (relevant tests, lint)
    2. Call planning_agent.plan(task) -> ExecutionPlan
    3. Save plan to database
    4. For each step in plan.steps:
        a. Call appropriate step handler (e.g., docs_step)
        b. Step creates commit
        c. Call review_agent.review(commit)
        d. If review fails: halt session
    5. Run task postflight
    6. Mark task complete in tracker
```

## Changes needed
- Add execute_task() method to TaskExecutor
- Wire up planning agent call
- Wire up step dispatch
- Wire up review agent call
- Update session status on completion/halt

## Acceptance
- Loop processes all ready tasks
- Each task goes through preflight→plan→execute→postflight
- Session halts on first error


```
States: none, red, green

  green → refactor (allowed)

  All other transitions: REJECTED
```

```python
        ...
```

## Integration
- Called by execution loop before each TDD step
- Raises error if invalid transition attempted

title: Implement TDD Refactor step
description:
Implement the TDD Refactor step for behavior-neutral improvements.

## Location
- `src/jiro/steps/tdd/refactor/` - existing framework

## Responsibilities
1. Receive ExecutionStep with refactoring goals
2. Call execution agent to refactor code
3. Run tests and verify they still PASS
4. Create commit with ♻️ prefix
5. Return commit for review

## Validation (before commit)
- Test files NOT modified
- Test command runs and PASSES
- Changes are behavior-neutral (LLM review validates this)

## Commit message template
```
♻️ Refactor: {description}

Task: {task_id} - {task_title}
Type: tdd_refactor
Verification: {test_command}
  {test_output showing pass}
```

## Acceptance
- tdd_refactor_step(step) -> Commit
- Tests still pass
- No test file changes
- Review validates behavior-neutral
